internalNote: Level 3 enrichment from a hymnary.org/hymnal/STH1913 CSV export Kevin supplied, 2026-09-09 - cross-checked field-for-field against the Level 2 page/title index added earlier the same day (independently pulled from hymnary's own table view) and found to match exactly across all 130 entries, no discrepancies. Numbered by hymn number, not page, matching hymnary's own numbering; the gaps in the sequence (3, 7, 9, 11, 13...) are real, confirmed across both sources, not an extraction artifact. Tune titles are title-cased per Kevin's instruction - both sources give them in all caps. This source has no meter, key, scripture reference, or copyright data for any entry - Kevin flagged this incompleteness himself before the CSV arrived, and none of it has been guessed or backfilled here. One entry, #129 "Detriot", is transcribed exactly as both independent sources have it; the tune's own identifier (detroit_kentuckyharmony) confirms it's the well-known tune "Detroit", so this is almost certainly a misspelling in the original 1913 print itself, not a transcription error on either source's part - left uncorrected rather than silently fixed. publicationStatus is "draft" pending a pass to backfill meter/key from another source, since this one doesn't carry it.
